1._section_summary: This section presents hierarchical moderated regression analyses examining how BMI and body size discrepancies (measures of body dissatisfaction) predict body appreciation and body image flexibility. Table 2 shows results for body appreciation (N=223), where BMI emerged as the strongest negative predictor (β = -0.43), and the discrepancy between current and personal ideal body size contributed additional variance. The full model explained 22% of variance in body appreciation, and none of the proposed interaction terms contributed unique variance.
